The Problem Most Coloring Prompts Miss

“Give me a cute coloring page” usually gives you something that looks great on screen but isn’t printable. Soft shading, hairlines, stray text, and tiny detail show up at 300 DPI.

  • Grey mush. Shading reads as speckle and ruins clean line art.
  • Hairlines that break. Thin strokes don’t hold up in home printing.
  • Too much detail. Built for adults, not small hands with crayons.
  • Stray text. Many models add captions or mangled letters.
  • Inconsistent output. Without one locked spec, every generation drifts.

How Kids’ Coloring Books Actually Sell on KDP and Etsy

Kids’ coloring is a proven, repeat-purchase category. Circana counted 16.7 million US children’s coloring and activity print units in 2025, up 18% on the year, according to Publishers Weekly. The catch: generic “kids coloring book” listings get buried. Specific themes, consistent print quality, and a clear age promise are what get found and bought.

Amazon KDP: Paperbacks, Printed on Demand

You upload the interior PDF and a cover. Amazon prints and ships every order, so there is no inventory and no upfront print cost.

  • The royalty math: At a list .99price of $9.99 or more on Amazon.com, KDP pays 60% of the price minus printing cost (50% below $9.99). A short black-and-white interior costs only a few dollars to print, so a $9.99 book can leave roughly $3–4 per sale. Always confirm in KDP’s own calculator.
  • Short books are normal: Kids’ coloring books can run 30–50 designs. At that length, 348 prompts cover roughly 7 to 11 separate books.
  • One theme per book: “Dinosaur Coloring Book for Ages 4–7” beats “Animal Coloring Book” in search. Launch the 12 themes as a series with matching covers so one buyer can become several.
  • Seasonal timing: Demand rises around back-to-school and the gift season from late October through December. Publish early enough to be indexed first.
  • Quality and disclosure: Amazon requires you to disclose AI-generated content and suppresses low-quality books however they were made. Check every page before you upload.

Etsy: Printable Pages as Digital Downloads

Parents, teachers, and homeschoolers search for instant printable pages. Etsy allows AI-assisted designs that you create from your own prompts, as long as you label the item correctly and disclose AI use.

  • Sell finished sets: For example, “29 Dinosaur Coloring Pages, Printable PDF.” One theme per listing, plus a multi-theme bundle as the bigger offer.
  • No fulfilment work: No printing, shipping, or inventory. Etsy listing, transaction, and payment-processing fees still apply.
  • Seasonal spikes: Halloween, Christmas, Easter, and back-to-school give you reasons to release new sets.
  • Show exactly what they get: Use real page previews, and state page count, size, and file format. Don’t imply anything that isn’t in the download.
  • Keep your records: Save your prompts and generated files. Add a plain disclosure line such as “Created with AI tools from my original prompts and creative direction.”

Critical Etsy Compliance Note

Never list .99this .xlsx file or the prompts on Etsy. Etsy’s Creativity Standards do not allow selling AI prompts. The correct approach: generate the coloring pages from these prompts, review them, compile them into a PDF, and list .99that PDF as a digital download with AI use disclosed. Always check Etsy’s current policy before listing.

Simple 4-Step Workflow

  1. Open the workbook. Filter column B to your chosen theme.
  2. Copy the prompt. Rename Character/Setting first if desired—leave the spec untouched. Then copy column E and paste it into your image generator.
  3. Test, then generate. Test 1–2 prompts first, then generate the rest with confidence. Save each page as it comes back.
  4. Compile into a PDF. Combine your saved pages into one file for KDP or print.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I get finished coloring pages?

No. You get 348 written prompts in an Excel (.xlsx) workbook. You generate the pages yourself with your image tool.

Can I sell this file on Etsy?

No. Etsy prohibits selling AI prompt bundles. You may sell the finished pages you generate from these prompts, as a digital download, with AI disclosure.

Do I need to buy an AI tool?

You need access to an image generator that produces line art. Test one prompt first to confirm it works with your tool.

Can I rename characters and settings?

Yes. Columns C (Character) and D (Setting) are editable. Do not edit the prompt in column E—the closing specification is what keeps pages printable.

What ages is this for?

Ages 4–7. Designed with large areas, simple shapes, and no tiny details.

Can I publish the finished pages on KDP?

Yes, as a paperback coloring book. Review every page, disclose AI-generated content in KDP, and confirm you have the rights to any names you publish. Use KDP’s royalty calculator to set your price.

How much will I earn?

No one can promise that. Your income depends on the theme you pick, the quality of your pages, your title and listing, your price, and competition. The page above shows how each platform pays so you can run your own numbers.

What exactly do I receive?

One .xlsx workbook with sheets: How To Use, All 348 Prompts, KDP & Etsy Specs, and Categories.
